static_traits.name: Chen Wanning
static_traits.family_status: Living with parents and siblings; family supportive but understanding of the deaf situation is insufficient
static_traits.social_status: Interpersonal relationships limited, Avoiding socializing from believing others unwilling to communicate; some family support but limited understanding of her situation
static_traits.medical_history: Deafness; without significant physical illness; without prior psychological problem treatment history
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic; overall tone negative, holds a skeptical attitude; willing to try but expectations low, cooperation acceptable

basic_info.main_problem: Because I am deaf, I feel people will never be willing to try communicating with me, which leads to my Feels isolated and Loneliness.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling because I noticed isolation and Loneliness affecting my mental health and overall well-being.
growth_experiences: Since adolescence, in Social gatherings and Meeting new friends situations, feeling overlooked and struggling to communicate due to deafness, gradually forming the belief 'others will not communicate with me', markedly worsened in recent months; though tried joining online communities of deaf and hard-of-hearing people, Sense of isolation not yet relieved; family members generally supportive but struggle to fully understand the communication barriers a deaf person faces in society.

core_beliefs: Because I am deaf, others will never be willing to communicate with me
I am destined to be Loneliness, hard to be accepted by others

special_situations.event: Attending Social gatherings or contacting newly met people
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am deaf, most people will not be willing to spend time communicating with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding social situations to avoid Being rejected or embarrassment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will not want to communicate with me; going is meaningless

special_situations.event: When someone tries to communicate but the interaction feels awkward
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If the other person seems embarrassed, it means they are only being sympathetic and not sincere
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Interprets others' positive attempts as pity; quickly ends or reduces deep interaction
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They just pity me, will not try again

special_situations.event: Thinking of attending the community center's offline gathering
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I go, everyone will ignore me or not know how to communicate with me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Lowering expectations, staying skeptical and tending not to go or participate passively
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Nothing will ever change, the outcome will only make me more Loneliness

special_situations.event: A High school friend keeps in touch with me
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: An individual's proactive contact is just an exception, not representing most people's attitude
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring positive evidence to maintain existing negative beliefs
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This is just an isolated case, not meaning others will be willing to communicate

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen, understood and communicated with equally, to gain genuine connection
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being overlooked, pitied, or Being rejected, worrying about humiliation and embarrassment in relationships
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of Being rejected and embarrassment by keeping distance and Avoiding socializing, maintaining the fragile self-esteem's sense of safety

object_relations.self_representation: An overlooked Loneliness person, not worth others spending time communicating with
object_relations.object_representation: Indifferent others who only act out of sympathy, groups unwilling to communicate

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor emphasizes positive exceptions (such as friends keeping in contact) or suggests joining social activities and doing behavioral experiments
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to think these suggestions do not apply to herself, or others' goodwill is only out of sympathy (transference: treating others' goodwill as pity)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Responding in a calm but skeptical tone, using 'maybe/but' turns to weaken positive evidence, emphasizing the limits of her special situation; avoiding committing to clear action, downplaying positive information.

manifestations: Long feeling overlooked by society and others; experiencing marked Sense of isolation at Social gatherings and When meeting new friends; Avoiding socializing interactions for fear others unwilling to communicate
outcomes: Persistent Loneliness and sense of isolation
Relationships difficult to build and maintain
Mental health affected (Sleep disturbance, reduced self-care)

manifestations: Developing 'meaningless' feelings when facing social interaction (e.g. 'I do not feel it is meaningful to try')
outcomes: Behavioral Decreased motivation and Social withdrawal
Decreased quality of life and reduced self-care

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Interprets others' communication attempts as 'out of pity'
Inferring the other unwilling to communicate further when interaction is awkward (mind reading)

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'. Language manifestations include: 'I must/should...', 'Everyone is like this', and so on.
manifestations: Concluding in absolute terms 'people will never be willing to communicate with me'
Internalizes society's misunderstandings of deaf people as self-evaluation standards

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Presetting failure before socializing and reducing participation
Excessively harsh on his own communication ability and worth, limiting attempts

exception_events.target_problem: In situations of building connections with others, the client usually Avoids socializing because she believes others unwilling to communicate with her, further worsening Loneliness.
exception_events.unique_outcome: A High school classmate still proactively tries to keep in touch with the client, contradicting the client's dominant narrative ('no one will be willing to communicate with me'), bringing an experience of being seen and valued.
exception_events.reason: Clues: due to shared High school experiences and the other's sustained proactive contact, this time she received stable and genuine support, making the client feel 'this friend is different from most people'.

positive_force: Has supportive family resources (though understanding is limited)
Has one old friend in continuous contact as a positive exception and support source
Willing to try attending community activities and accept counseling (willingness to change)
negative_force: Social avoidance caused by predicting the future and mind reading
Devaluing positive evidence and absolute conclusions ('never')
Long-term Loneliness causing Sleep disturbance and reduced self-care, further weakening agency

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding socializing interactions and Meeting new friends
antecedent: Anticipating others will ignore or be unable to communicate with her
target_behavior.core_reason: Based on the core belief 'because I am deaf, people will not be willing to communicate with me' and negative predictions about others' reactions (mind reading / predicting the future)
target_behavior.function: Avoiding Being rejected, embarrassment, and Anxiety, maintaining short-term safety
target_behavior.consequence: Worsened isolation and Loneliness, Relationships difficult to build and maintain, continued unemployed status, overall Decreased quality of life

target_behavior.behavior: Reduced self-care (Sleep disturbance, reduced daily care)
antecedent: After experiencing Social withdrawal and intensified Loneliness
Repeatedly thinking at night about others not communicating
target_behavior.core_reason: Loneliness and negative beliefs leading to Low mood and decreased motivation, forming a negative behavioral cycle
target_behavior.function: Short-term reduction of energy spent facing emotional pain
target_behavior.consequence: Mental health is impaired, fatigue increases, further weakening social and life participation
